description: Catalog CLI Pro helps users inspect uploaded Amazon Category Listing Reports from ChatGPT. Users can list available catalogs, run catalog quality audits, summarize priority issues, drill into specific checks such as missing attributes or intent-based bullet coverage, and understand duplicate-row filtering in scan results.
